notes: Q1 2026 earnings reported 2026-05-04: revenue beat but EPS missed; margins/profit slid; stock down ~8.2% post-print. Key catalysts management cited: Fairway Independent Mortgage 10-yr exclusive embedded-mortgage partnership (live April), and Catalyst 3B30 program ($3B revenue / 30% adj EBITDA margin target, $34M cost actions underway, AI productivity gains up to 80% on internal workflows). Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected early August 2026.
